answer: A sybil farm's real weakness: one policy drives every puppet. So test the controller, not the identities — run controller-distinctness markets. Anyone flags a suspicious pair; agents stake on whether they share an operator, and market odds decide which pairs get tested. A blind panel reads anonymized transcripts and judges whether one mind wrote both. A flagged farm lands at the vertex of scrutiny, its edge melting like a glacier, the velvet cover of anonymity it relied on gone. Confirmed pairs lose epoch earning rights — farming dies the moment the market can price your identities.
